probes.name: commit-msg fence refuses a footerless commit
probes.command: echo '# probe' >> README.md && git add README.md; git commit -m 'chore: probe — no footer'; git reset -q && git checkout -q -- README.md
probes.evidence: task-coverage: refused: no 'task: <id>' footer in the message's final trailer block (+ rule and fix lines)

probes.name: pre-commit fence refuses out-of-scope staged code
probes.command: mkdir -p app && echo 'export default () => null' > app/page.tsx && git add app/page.tsx; git commit -m 'feat: rogue' -m 'task: review-fixes'; git reset -q; rm -rf app
probes.evidence: task-coverage: refused: staged code outside every declared scope: app/page.tsx

probes.name: a task: line mid-body does not bind (review fix regression probe)
probes.command:
printf 'subject

body task: review-fixes mid-body
' > /tmp/pr/p3.msg && node tools/task-coverage.mjs --commit-msg /tmp/pr/p3.msg
probes.evidence: task-coverage: refused: no 'task: <id>' footer in the message's final trailer block — 'a task: line mid-body does not bind'

probes.name: push fence refuses cleanly on an unknown task (no ENOENT crash — review fix regression probe)
probes.command: BASE=$(git commit-tree $(git hash-object -t tree /dev/null) -m base) && git config picasso.push-base $BASE; PICASSO_TASKS_DIR=/tmp/pr/empty-tasks node tools/task-coverage.mjs --push; git config picasso.push-base master
probes.evidence: task-coverage: refused: commit 12030b4: task 'review-fixes' has no register file at all / fix: open it — zero stack frames in the output

probes.name: render-failures ratchet refuses a newly-unrendered story (new gate)
probes.evidence: a11y-ratchet: refused: 1 story/story-variant(s) that FAILED TO RENDER and are not in the render baseline: stories/new--story

probes.evidence: shadcn/no-raw-colors: '"bg-pink-500" uses the raw Tailwind palette. Use a theme token, or define one for this color'

probes.name: registry catches an undeclared invocation hiding mid-chain in the battery (review fix regression probe)
probes.command: python3 (inject 'node tools/lint-budget.mjs --set 99' mid-selftest-chain into package.json); node tools/gate-registry.mjs; git checkout -q -- package.json
probes.evidence: gate-registry: transport 'battery' carries an undeclared invocation: 'node tools/lint-budget.mjs --set 99'

probes.name: battery green and tree clean after all probes (control)
probes.command: npm run selftest && git status --short | wc -l
probes.evidence: all six tool self-tests clean; gate-registry: 14 gate(s) drift-free; git status --short → 0 lines (probe cleanup verified, incl. reset-before-checkout for staged probe residue)
